BiblicalUsage: Paul says destruction and misery are in the ways of those who have not known the way of peace. James tells the rich to weep and howl for the miseries coming upon them. The word is wretchedness, calamity: the end of a road walked without God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe both verses are warnings, not taunts: misery follows the ways that leave God out, and the warning is given so we will turn.
RelatedPeople: Paul; James, Brother of the Lord
